definitions: A group of senior opposition spokespeople who form an alternative cabinet to that of the government, each shadowing a corresponding government minister.
The team of senior members of the main opposition party in the UK Parliament who would form the cabinet if their party were in power.
examples: The Shadow Cabinet met to discuss the new policy.
She was appointed to the Shadow Cabinet as the new Shadow Secretary of State for Health.
The leader of the opposition announced changes to his Shadow Cabinet.
